scenarios.name: Inspect marking-menu sub-environment choices without changing selection

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the customization dialog is open on the Marking Menu tab in the MCAD Software
the user opens the Sub-Environment selector
the available choices include "Arc", "Circle", "Dimension", "Line", "Point", "Sketch Block", "Sketch Pattern", "Spline" and "Text"
the user dismisses the selector without choosing an option
